description: Estimate asphalt volume, US short tons and metric tonnes, with optional exact-cent material cost, from a rectangle or area and compacted depth. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/asphalt-calc

density.description: Density (lb/ft³) — Editable, 100 to 170. About 145 is a common hot-mix starting value.

pricePerTon.description: Price per US ton (optional) — Dollars and cents, no symbols. Leave blank to skip cost.

waste.description: Waste allowance (%) — Extra material for cuts and breakage, as a percent. Enter 0 for none.
